variables.description: Hidden counters watching for organically developing techniques.
variables.behaviorRules: Never shown to the player. Object keyed by candidate id: {"pattern":"counter after last-moment dodge","attempts":7,"successes":4,"enemyTypes":["goblin","wolf"],"underPressure":2,"base":"swordsmanship"}. Increment silently when the player genuinely repeats a specific tactic. Do NOT grant a technique after one lucky attempt. A candidate becomes real at roughly 12+ attempts with 6+ successes across at least 3 distinct enemy types or situations, including at least 2 under real pressure, with the underlying skill at a plausible level.

variables.name: Combat
variables.description: Live encounter state while in-combat is true.
variables.behaviorRules: Each combatant: {"name":"...","hp":19,"maxHp":19,"mana":0,"stam":10,"pos":"10 ft, flanking left","init":14,"cond":[],"morale":"steady","cooldowns":{}}. Initiative is 3d6 + Agility modifier, rolled once at the start unless circumstances fundamentally change. Clear this object when combat ends, after writing any resulting injuries and loot to their own variables.

variables.name: Codex
variables.description: Earned titles, recorded lore, identified monsters and learned recipes.
variables.behaviorRules: Titles are extraordinary accomplishments, never additional guild ranks. Bestiary entries unlock as the player actually fights or studies a creature and record its real weaknesses. Recipes are only usable if listed here.

variables.name: Age
variables.description: Character age in years.
variables.behaviorRules: Set during character creation; change only as world years pass.

variables.name: Gender
variables.description: Character sex selected at creation.
variables.behaviorRules: Set during character creation to exactly "Male" or "Female". This world uses those two character-creation selections only. Do not leave blank after creation and do not change it unless an explicit magical transformation or similarly extraordinary in-world event actually changes the character.

variables.name: Appearance
variables.description: Persistent physical appearance summary.
variables.behaviorRules: Set during creation; update only for real lasting changes.

variables.name: Origin
variables.description: Where the character comes from / prior life.
variables.behaviorRules: Set during creation; never silently rewrite.

variables.name: Background
variables.description: Mechanical/social background chosen at creation.
variables.behaviorRules: Set at creation; grants starting skills/contacts only as explicitly defined.

variables.name: Displayed Title
variables.description: Current chosen/recognized title.
variables.behaviorRules: Must be earned and present in codex.titles before display as an official title.

variables.name: Player Journal
variables.description: Personal journal/objectives maintained by the player.
variables.behaviorRules: Player-facing notes. Push/delete only when player adds/removes or a UI journal action does so.

variables.name: Starting Realm
variables.description: The Great Realm selected at character creation. Used to anchor the opening and provenance.
variables.behaviorRules: Set exactly once at character creation from one of: Aurelia, Stonehold, Sylvanor, Drakmor, Sunscar, Velkar, Umbral Reach. Do not silently change it later; current-region may change through travel.

variables.name: Regional Markets
variables.description: Persistent local supply, demand and price conditions by settlement/category.
variables.behaviorRules: Object keyed by settlement id. Each value may contain categories keyed by commodity category: {supply:1,demand:1,event:1,season:1,route:1,finalDynamic:1,cause:[],updatedDate:'',expiresOrReview:''}. Multipliers are relative to that settlement's regional baseline. Only create records for meaningful deviations; absence means 1.0 dynamic conditions. Update when major purchases/sales, events, production, route changes, seasons or recovery materially alter a market. Do not reveal unknown markets to the player.

variables.name: Known Market Prices
variables.description: Price observations and reports the player has legitimately learned.
variables.behaviorRules: Object keyed by settlement/category or item. Record {buyCp,sellCp,observedDate,source,reliability}. Update from actual shop visits, posted boards, trusted reports or successful information gathering. Never auto-fill from omniscient market-state. Old observations remain but are visibly dated/stale.

variables.name: Trade Cargo Ledger
variables.description: Bulk trade lots whose acquisition cost/origin matter for profit and saturation.
variables.behaviorRules: Array of {id,item,category,qty,unitCostCp,totalCostCp,origin,acquiredDate,condition,weightEach,legalStatus,notes}. Keep synchronized with inventory for economically significant cargo. Remove/decrement when sold, consumed, lost or spoiled.

variables.name: Trade History
variables.description: Meaningful completed bulk trades and net outcomes.

variables.name: Known Quest Boards
variables.description: Persistent state for physical request/quest boards the character has actually discovered or inspected. Each board stores settlement, district, profile, access rules, refresh time and currently visible posts.
variables.behaviorRules: Object keyed by board id. Board example: {"aurelia-guild-common":{"name":"Aurelia Guild — Common Hall Board","settlement":"Aurelia City","district":"Guild District","profile":"guild","access":"public","lastRefresh":"1247-03-03 08:00","posts":[{"id":"req-...","title":"...","rank":"E","issuer":"...","summary":"...","rewardCp":5000,"deadline":"...","posted":"...","status":"available","crossPosted":[]}]}}. Only boards the player has discovered/inspected belong here. Remove or update posts when accepted, expired, withdrawn, completed by rivals, or moved. Never duplicate the same request reward through cross-posting. When inspecting a canonical board in quest-board-registry, create/update its quest-boards record and populate persistent posts from current world state. S-rank posts normally require sovereign authorization and should carry sovereignIssuer/authorization fields.

variables.name: Request Market State
variables.description: Hidden simulation state for local request supply, demand, adventurer competition, crises and board refresh pressure by settlement/district.
variables.behaviorRules: Track behind-the-scenes request pressure by settlement and category. Example {"Aurelia City":{"monster":1.1,"escort":0.9,"crime":1.2,"healing":0.8,"competition":1.1,"crisis":null,"updated":"1247-03-03"}}. This state drives realistic board composition. Do not expose hidden values directly unless learned in-world.

variables.name: Unspent Advancement Points
variables.description: Attribute advancement points banked from level-ups, spent by the player through the character sheet.
variables.behaviorRules:
READ-ONLY TO YOU. One point is granted per character level and banked here until the player spends it. Points STACK indefinitely — a player who ignores three level-ups has three points waiting.

The player allocates these themselves in their character sheet interface. You must NEVER: ask where they want to put their points, allocate points on their behalf, raise an attribute as a level-up reward, or narrate an attribute increase that the player did not confirm. Attribute values change through the sheet, not through you.

You MAY reference the banked total in narration when it is natural — a mentor noting untapped potential, a character feeling capability they have not yet claimed. Keep it light and infrequent.

Attribute increases that come from genuinely extraordinary in-world events (a divine boon, a transformative curse, an artifact) are a separate matter and are written directly to the attributes variable, not through this pool.

variables.name: Advancement Points Granted Through Level
variables.description: Engine bookkeeping: highest character level for which advancement points have already been granted. Prevents double-granting and enables stacking.
variables.behaviorRules: Engine-owned high-water mark. Never referenced in narration.

variables.name: Combat Music Enabled
variables.description: UI audio preference. When false, combat BGM conditionals do not replace the current peaceful/location melody.
variables.behaviorRules: UI-owned audio preference. The GM must not alter this variable as part of narrative play, sync, rewards, combat, travel, or world simulation.

variables.name: Mana Awakened
variables.description: Whether this character's mana access has genuinely awakened. Casting is impossible until this is true.
variables.behaviorRules: False until the character's mana is genuinely awakened by an in-world event: a dangerous situation forcing an instinctive cast, a deliberate awakening rite guided by a trainer, priest or order, exposure to a raw mana font or artifact, a supernatural blessing or pact, or a formal arcane academy's opening ritual. Starting casters (Mage, Cleric, Paladin, Bard, Druid, Occultist, Wyldcaster) begin already awakened as part of their pre-campaign training, per the starting-calling origin exception. A non-caster may awaken later through genuine play. Never flip this true because the player merely declares they can now use magic. Once true it never reverts except through an extraordinary, clearly narrated effect (a terrible curse, a mana-searing wound).

variables.name: Instinct Pressure
variables.description: Raw, unstable magical potential built up by casting on instinct rather than trained technique.
variables.behaviorRules: Rises only from casting on instinct rather than trained technique: a desperate cast under real danger, a spontaneous cast never drilled or taught, or deliberately overcharging a spell past its safe parameters. Rise 5-15 on a genuine instinctive/desperate cast, 15-25 on a reckless overcharge. Decays slowly on its own: 2-5 per full rest or quiet day, faster (10-15) with deliberate meditation or a control lesson aimed at calming it. Never move this for an ordinary trained cast performed calmly within known limits — that is what control-level tracks, not this. Never below 0 or above 100.

variables.name: Control Level
variables.description: Stability over magic earned through real training and discipline.
variables.behaviorRules: Rises only through genuine training effort: a real trainer's lesson in mana discipline or control, dedicated meditation/breathing practice, deliberate calm practice-casting, or a hard-won lesson studied after surviving a backlash. Use skill-like point weight: a real teacher's session raises this 2-5, a day of solo disciplined practice 1-2, studying a survived backlash 3-8. Never raise this for a reckless or desperate cast itself — that raises instinct-pressure instead, never this. Ceiling 100; growth above roughly 80 should require a genuinely accomplished teacher or milestone.

variables.name: Backlash Risk
variables.description: Computed automatically: how far instinct-pressure has outrun control-level. Engine-owned, never set directly.
variables.behaviorRules: Read-only — never set this directly, it is computed from instinct-pressure minus control-level. Narrate by band: 0-14 calm and stable. 15-34 occasional flickers, minor static, nothing dangerous. 35-59 Volatile — visible side-effects, minor fatigue on heavy casts, and any Wild Cast should trigger a resolution check per Intuitive Casting, Mana Awakening & Backlash. 60-84 Dangerous — real chance of a backlash or wild surge on any bold cast. 85-100 Critical — backlash near-certain on anything but the gentlest trained spell.

description: A simulation-grade high-fantasy RPG. Register with the Adventurer's Guild as an F-Rank nobody and become whatever your actual choices make you. Skills level through use and instruction, techniques are invented rather than unlocked, trainers are real people scattered across a continent with fixed coordinates, monsters are populations rather than encounters, and the world keeps moving whether or not you are watching. 3d6 resolution. No level cap. No plot armor. The world does not scale to you. Includes a persistent dynamic regional economy with supply, demand, route disruption, seasonal pricing, market saturation, arbitrage, cargo logistics, and player-known price intelligence.
